Later source rework commits converted that spreadsheet input into the current StructureDefinition and search-parameter bundle forms while preserving the encounter element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Flag in the active resource list. Later FHIR-11203 timing guidance and the FHIR-32351 Encounter.actualPeriod rename refine adjacent Flag.encounter wording without contradicting the encounter support. FHIR-11203 is already represented on the combined branch and was not duplicated.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml already defines Flag.encounter as 0..1 Reference(Encounter) with the requested encounter relevance definition, source/flag/bundle-Flag-search-params.xml already contains the encounter search parameter, and source/flag/flag-example-encounter.xml demonstrates the element.
